import hashlib, html, json, pathlib, re, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

folder = pathlib.Path("products/services/wp-buyer-sample")
source = (folder / "official-feed.xml").read_bytes()
digest = hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest()
assert digest == "5e6e5c1f17a436b4b67613b887153fa504415b2b9f417f80c43a92a3f09940e6"
items = ET.fromstring(source).findall("./channel/item")
decisions = {
    "wordpress-expert-38": ("We will need an expert to look into our WordPress back end.", "The buyer leaves scope to a later conversation. No discrete import QA requirement or explicit compensation appears in the listing text."),
    "web-site-developer-project": ("We do not want AI-dependent web development.", "The buyer expressly excludes AI-dependent development. The project also bundles migration of user records with a full Drupal-to-WordPress rebuild."),
    "wordpress-website-developer-18": ("The mandatory platform is WordPress using the Gutenberg block editor, Kadence Theme and Kadence Blocks.", "The paid fixed-price job seeks a complete six-page build in a specified WordPress stack. The listing gives no separately purchasable catalogue CSV, migration or import QA deliverable.")
}
screen = []
for item in items:
    url = item.findtext("link")
    slug = url.rstrip("/").split("/")[-1]
    if slug not in decisions:
        continue
    quote, reason = decisions[slug]
    body = item.findtext("{http://purl.org/rss/1.0/modules/content/}encoded")
    assert quote in html.unescape(re.sub("<[^>]+>", " ", body))
    screen.append(dict(url=url, title=html.unescape(item.findtext("title")), published=item.findtext("pubDate"), buyer_quote=quote, exclusion=reason))
assert len(screen) == 3
result = dict(verdict="NO_FIT_IN_BOUNDED_SCREEN", source_url="https://jobs.wordpress.net/feed/", source_sha256=digest, feed_items=len(items), inspected_listings=screen, scope="Official RSS capture only. The three scope exclusions were sufficient before verifying response rules or current availability.", sample_executed=False, external_application_sent=False, reopening_trigger="A specific current buyer-authored listing explicitly commissioning a paid standalone catalogue CSV, migration or import QA task with a testable criterion, a permitted response route and terms compatible with disclosed AI assistance.")
path = folder / "bounded-decision.json"
path.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+"\n", encoding="utf-8")
print(path.read_text())
